title: zetta.SignalEnvelope
description: The wire envelope for one signal carried by the cluster transport's `ZETTA/1 SIGNAL <envelope>` frame: an ephemeral RPC request/response, event, or task. The opaque application payload is base64-encoded into the `payload` string (binary-safe). Mirrors the embedded copy in src/core/signal.cpp, which is the copy enforced at runtime. The kind-specific required fields (a request/response needs `id`; a request/event/task needs `method`; a response needs `ok`) are enforced in code on top of this schema.
